metric_definition: Mean costs aggregate only the 500 unique valid terminal episodes in each cell, including successes and scientific failures. Technical-failure attempts are excluded from these means and retained separately. Sampling is returned policy_queries; flow=NFE10*sampling.
sparse_counter_policy: Explicit_rows and structural_zero_rows are separate. A zero-intervention episode cannot execute a correction gradient; N/R cannot execute Q/action-gradient. Missing nonstructural values are left unknown, never filled as zero.
caveats: No new blind test: fixed already revealed MT50 500-source set. No selection or calibration on these values.
Frozen per-model L11 fit9101 and native10 D/G0 heads; no per-H retraining/calibration.
SmolVLA raw50, X-VLA raw30; natural H independent of correction C10.
Velocity remains other-work data, excluded from Post paper.
A publication retried on CPU; publication attempts are not scientific episode attempts. B r2 startup failure consumed no episode and is preserved; r3 terminates complete.
